authenticity_review: The image demonstrates exceptional photorealism for an AI-generated scene. Lighting physics are accurate: soft window light creates consistent specular highlights on the curved metal surfaces and casts natural contact shadows on the wood grain. Depth of field is applied correctly, isolating the subjects from the blurred background. Structural integrity is sound; the segmentation mask (confidence 0.96) shows clean boundaries with no fragmentation or ghosting. The animal pose auditor reported MINIMAL artifact risk (only 1 low-confidence keypoint out of 51), confirming anatomical plausibility even in this stylized form. Minor variations in rivet placement are consistent with real-world mechanical assembly rather than generation artifacts. No melting, fusion, or texture anomalies were detected by any expert tool.
